verdict.rationale: A framework's tooling could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The pack shows no such assistant. The only related item is a built-in MCP endpoint that lets external coding agents access a running app. That is an adjacent integration point for third-party agents, not an in-product assistant that users delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
